title: Legacy Cryptographic Hash Function (SHA-1)
description: Tests Python hashlib instantiation with SHA-1 algorithm.

expected_findings.evaluation_notes: Scanners must extract SHA-1 algorithm. Operational role is determinable as message_digest based on hashlib usage. SHA-1 produces a 160-bit message digest output; key_size_bits is null because hash functions do not utilize cryptographic keys. Schema limitation: answer_key.schema.json does not define a digest_size_bits parameter field, so digest size is documented here.

verification_metadata.verification_method: Manual Source Code Inspection & Python Standard Library Cross-Check
